changelog.title: Initial Release v1.0.0
changes: Live Modrinth Plugin Manager with real-time search & 25+ curated catalog
Multi-Platform Server JAR resolver (Auto Paper/Spigot detection)
Direct installation for ViaVersion, ViaBackwards, LuckPerms, EssentialsX, Geyser, etc.
Multi-Version Java Manager (Java 25, 21, 17) with auto-detection & manual override
Direct GitHub Hot-Update engine (sync latest code on relaunch without redownloading .exe)
Automated Minecraft Paper server creation and live interactive console
Advanced File Manager with protected .jar viewer and in-app file editor
World Manager with zip import/export, Player Manager, and Server Properties editor
Automated backup system (full server or worlds only)
Premium dark glassmorphism theme with smooth micro-animations
